name: first-deploy
title: A first deploy, from nothing
alt: zekno deploy in a folder with a Compose file and nothing set up. It asks for your name and makes your key, with its team code; asks where the server is and a name for it, connects over SSH, finds Docker, installs the runner and adds the server, with its server code; asks a name for the app and whether to remember the folder; asks for the one value the Compose file expects without showing it; then deploys, and shop is live on prod-1.

fixed.what: the team code, made from a key created on each run
the server code, made from the key the runner creates on each run
the runner's size: the stand-in release is a small script; 110 MB is the size apps/runner/README.md gives for the runner file
how long the deploy took, read from the clock

lines: Nothing is set up on this machine yet. Three things first: your key, a server, this app.
Key created. It is in your system keychain.
Identifies your team. A server checks it before it agrees to obey your team.
Added prod-1 to the signed team list
Identifies this server's key. Teammates compare it before they trust the server.
You reached this server over SSH, so its identity rests on SSH's host verification.
It writes zekno.json, so it always deploys shop to prod-1.
compose.yaml expects 1 value that has no secret yet.
zekno logs to watch it, zekno rollback to undo
